01

“If you are grateful, I will surely increase you”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 14:7).

461
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 461: 1: 17

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
461: 1:17. Sufyan said: Some of our companions related to us from Mujahid, on His words
"If you are grateful, I will surely increase you": He said, from obeying Me, from Him (verse 7).
العربية
461: 1: 17 سفيان ثَنَا بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ لَئِنْ شَكَرْتُمْ لأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ قال من إطاعتي منه (الآية 7) .

02

“it yields its fruit every hin”

An explanation transmitted from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 14:25).

462
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr No. 462: 2: 4

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
462: 2:4. Sufyan, from Tariq ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Said ibn Jubayr, on His words
"it yields its fruit every hin": He said, hin is a year (verse 25).
العربية
462: 2: 4 سفيان عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فِي قوله أكلها كل حين قال الحين السنة (الآية 25) .
Edition record 371395 · p. 156Link to report ↗
03

“God keeps firm those who believe with the firm word in worldly life…”

An explanation transmitted from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib (Q 14:27).

463
Explanation from al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib No. 463: 3: 5

al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib

English
Transmission wording
463: 3:5. Sufyan, from Zubayd, from Khaythama, from al-Bara ibn Azib:
"God keeps firm those who believe with the firm word in worldly life and in the Hereafter": He said, the grave (verse 27).
العربية
463: 3: 5 سفيان عَنْ زُبَيْدٍ عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ عَنِ البراء بن عازب اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الآخِرَةِ قال القبر (الآية 27) .
Edition record 371395 · p. 156Link to report ↗
04

“Have you not seen those who exchanged the favor of God for disbelief…”

An explanation transmitted from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib (Q 14:28).

464
Explanation from ʿAlī No. 464: 4: 1

ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib

English
Transmission wording
464: 4:1. Abu Hudhayfa related to us; Sufyan related to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Amr, from Ali ibn Abi Talib, on His words
"Have you not seen those who exchanged the favor of God for disbelief and brought their people down to the home of ruin," Hell: He said, they are the two most wicked of Quraysh, the Banu Umayya and the Banu al-Mughira. As for the Banu al-Mughira, God cut off their rear; as for the Banu Umayya, they were given enjoyment for a time (verse 28).
العربية
464: 4: 1 حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حُذَيْفَةَ ثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عن أبي إسحق عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أبي طالب في قوله تر إلى الذين بدلوا نعمة اللَّهِ كُفْرًا وَأَحَلُّوا قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ البوار جهنم قَالَ هُمَا الأَفْجَرَانِ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ بَنُو أُمَيَّةَ وَبَنُو الْمُغِيرَةِ فَأَمَّا بَنُو الْمُغِيرَةِ فَقَطَعَ اللَّهُ أَدْبَارَهُمْ وَأَمَّا بَنُو أُمَيَّةَ فَمُتِّعُوا إِلَى حين (الآية 28) .
Edition record 371396 · p. 157Link to report ↗
05

“Make the hearts of the people incline toward them”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 14:37).

465
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 465: 5: 6

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
465: 5:6. Sufyan, from Mujahid, who said:
Had Abraham said, "Make the hearts of the people incline toward them," Persia and Rome would have crowded you out of it; but he said, "hearts from among the people" (verse 37).
العربية
465: 5: 6 سفيان عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ لَوْ قَالَ إبراهيم اجعل أفيدة النَّاسِ تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ لَزَاحَمَكُمْ: عَلَيْهِ فارس والروم ولكن قال أفيدة من الناس (الآية 37) .
Edition record 371396 · p. 157Link to report ↗
06

“hastening [muhtiin]”

An explanation transmitted from Abū al-Ḍuḥā (Q 14:43).

466
Explanation from Abū al-Ḍuḥā No. 466: 6: 8

Abū al-Ḍuḥā

English
Transmission wording
466: 6:8. Sufyan, from Said, from Abu al-Duha:
"hastening [muhtiin]": He said, it is the lowering of the neck... and he described it with his head, raising it to the sky, with eyes fixed (verse 43).
العربية
466: 6: 8 سفيان عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى مهطعين قال هو التجنيح غير وَوَصَفَهُ بِرَأْسِهِ أَنَّهُ يَرْفَعُهُ إِلَى السماء وشخص بصره (الآية 43) .
Edition record 371396 · p. 157Link to report ↗
07

“Their plot was such that mountains would be moved by it”

An explanation transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 14:46).

467
Explanation from Sufyān No. 467: 7: 20

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
467: 7:20. Sufyan said: The reading of Abd Allah was
"Their plot was such that mountains would be moved by it" (verse 46).
العربية
467: 7: 20 سُفْيَانُ قال كانت قراءة عبد الله كَادَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ الْجِبَالُ (الآية 46) .
Edition record 371397 · p. 158Link to report ↗
08

“the day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens”

An explanation transmitted from Amr ibn Maymun (Q 14:48).

468
Explanation from Amr ibn Maymun No. 468: 8: 2

Amr ibn Maymun

English
Transmission wording
468: 8:2. Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from Amr ibn Maymun:
"the day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens": He said, it will be replaced by a white earth like silver, on which no sin has ever been committed and on which no unlawful blood has ever been shed (verse 48).
العربية
468: 8: 2 سفيان عن أبي إسحق عن عمرو بن ميمون تبدل الأرض غير الأرض والسماوات أحمد قَالَ تُبَدَّلُ بِأَرْضٍ بَيْضَاءَ كَالْفِضَّةِ لَمْ تَعْمَلْ فِيهَا خَطِيَّةٌ قَطُّ وَلَمْ يُسْفَكْ فِيهَا دَمٌ حَرَامٌ قط (الآية 48) .
